properties.comment:
MTPASA_CASESOLUTION is obsolete from 2017 End of Year DM4.27 Release. 
The MTPASA_REGIONSOLUTION table shows the results of the regional capacity, maximum surplus reserve and maximum spare capacity evaluations for each day and ldcblock of the study.

fields.doc: Date processing of the run begins
fields.name: RUN_DATETIME

fields.doc: Unique run id. Generated from the solution file caseid
fields.name: RUN_NO

fields.doc: Sunday at start of the week for this solutions energy block. Generated from the solution file energy block
fields.name: ENERGYBLOCK

fields.doc: Day this solution is for. Generated from the solution file periodid
fields.name: DAY

fields.doc: LDC block this solution is for. Generated from the solution file periodid
fields.name: LDCBLOCK

fields.doc: The unique region identifier
fields.name: REGIONID

fields.doc: Input value for 10% probability demand
fields.name: DEMAND10

fields.doc: Not used from 21/05/2010. Prior to 21/05/2010: Input reserve requirement
fields.name: RESERVEREQ

fields.doc: Not used from 21/05/2010. Prior to 21/05/2010: CA Demand + Reserve Requirement
fields.name: CAPACITYREQ

fields.doc: Sum of: (Region Period Demand - given Demand10)/PeriodLength(sum by Energy Block, entered in first period of energy block, GWh)
fields.name: ENERGYREQDEMAND10

fields.doc: Region energy unconstrained MW capacity subject to network security constraints
fields.name: UNCONSTRAINEDCAPACITY

fields.doc: Region energy constrained MW capacity subject to energy and network security constraints
fields.name: CONSTRAINEDCAPACITY

fields.doc: Calculated in capacity adequacy evaluation: Export if > 0, Import if < 0.
fields.name: NETINTERCHANGEUNDERSCARCITY

fields.doc: Regional surplus capacity MW, +/- values indicate surplus/deficit capacity
fields.name: SURPLUSCAPACITY

fields.doc: Not used from 21/05/2010. Prior to 21/05/2010: Regional reserve surplus. +/-0 values indicate surplus/deficit reserve
fields.name: SURPLUSRESERVE

fields.doc: The regional reserve condition: 0 = Adequate, 1 = LRC
fields.name: RESERVECONDITION

fields.doc: The Maximum generation (MW) that could be withdrawn from this region without incurring a Low Reserve Condition.
fields.name: MAXSURPLUSRESERVE

fields.doc: The Maximum Spare Capacity evaluated for this region in this period. Calculated for each region in turn
fields.name: MAXSPARECAPACITY

fields.doc: The LOR Condition determined from the Maximum Spare Capacity value: 0 = no condition, 1 = LOR1 condition, 2 = LOR2 condition, 3 = LOR3 condition
fields.name: LORCONDITION

fields.doc: Sum of  MAXAVAIL quantities offered by all Scheduled Generators in a given Region for a given PERIODID.
fields.name: AGGREGATECAPACITYAVAILABLE

fields.doc: Sum of  MAXAVAIL quantities bid by of all Scheduled Loads in a given Region for a given PERIODID.
fields.name: AGGREGATESCHEDULEDLOAD

fields.doc: Date the solution was loaded
fields.name: LASTCHANGED

fields.doc: Sum of  PASAAVAILABILITY quantities offered by all Scheduled Generators in a given Region for a given PERIODID.
fields.name: AGGREGATEPASAAVAILABILITY

fields.doc: Type of run.  Values are RELIABILITY_LRC and OUTAGE_LRC
fields.name: RUNTYPE

fields.doc: Region Reserve Level for LOR1 used. Can be static value or calculated value if an interconnector is a credible contingency
fields.name: CALCULATEDLOR1LEVEL

fields.doc: Region Reserve Level for LOR2 used. Can be static value or calculated value if an interconnector is a credible contingency
fields.name: CALCULATEDLOR2LEVEL

fields.doc: Net interconnector flow from the region for this interval from the MSR assessment
fields.name: MSRNETINTERCHANGEUNDERSCARCITY

fields.doc: Net interconnector flow from the region for this interval from the LOR assessment
fields.name: LORNETINTERCHANGEUNDERSCARCITY

fields.doc: Allowance made for non-scheduled generation in the demand forecast (MW).
fields.name: TOTALINTERMITTENTGENERATION

fields.doc: Input value for 50% probability demand
fields.name: DEMAND50

fields.doc: Sum of Cleared Scheduled generation, imported generation (at the region boundary) and allowances made for non-scheduled generation (MW).
fields.name: DEMAND_AND_NONSCHEDGEN

fields.doc: Regional aggregated Unconstrained Intermittent Generation Forecast of Semi-scheduled generation (MW).
fields.name: UIGF

fields.doc: Aggregate Regional UIGF availability
fields.name: SEMISCHEDULEDCAPACITY

fields.doc: Aggregate Regional UIGF availability for LOR
fields.name: LOR_SEMISCHEDULEDCAPACITY
